Hi John — great speaking with you this morning. Quick recap + recommended next steps based on the pilot/enterprise paths we discussed.

Quick recap:
- Pilot: recommend Redwood Hosted (our hosted API) for fastest time-to-value. For pilots we commonly accept card or PO; small pilot POs (<= $25k) can be handled with a short order form and monthly invoicing.
- Dedicated / Private for production: if you expect steady high-volume inference and need isolation, Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) or Private (VPC/on-prem) are the options. Those are usually sold as committed capacity (12/24 month) with monthly invoicing and can include a marketplace listing if you want.

Commercial options to match FinCo rules (high level):
- Hosted (on-demand) — no commit, pay-as-you-go; easiest to start and accepts card immediately. Good for discovery and small pilots.
- Hosted (small commit) — 1-3 month commit to lower unit costs; still hosted and managed.
- Dedicated (committed) — 12+ month commit, dedicated pool, SLA-backed; invoiced monthly via PO.
- Private (VPC/on-prem) — enterprise contract + platform fee; invoiced via PO; longer procurement.

Marketplace: we do have an AWS Marketplace listing in progress and can provide a marketplace order form — that often speeds up vendor onboarding for finance.

Next steps I can do today:
- Share a short SOW + draft order form (attached).
- Share a pricing range for the pilot (hosted on-demand vs small commit) and a draft PO-friendly invoice template.
- If you prefer PO, let me know the billing contact and any PO processing timelines so we can align.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf; Pricing sheet link included below.
